title: Rahnuma syllabus links and a standard syllabus, draft
description: Links to the official syllabi of CBSE, CISCE (ICSE and ISC), Cambridge IGCSE and A Level, the IB, GATE, Indian state boards and boards abroad, with the guide's own correlation keywords, matched on the reader's device, and a standard syllabus built from the guide, level by level, as a draft for review. No syllabus text is stored.
